headline: EU Council extends sanctions over violations of Ukraine's territorial integrity for 3 years instead of 6 months, removes three individuals, one entity from list
summary: The Council of the European Union extended restrictive measures over violations of Ukraine's territorial integrity for 36 months, until September 22, 2029, instead of six months. Three individuals and one entity were removed from the list.
why: EU sanctions restrict asset access and transactions for listed persons and entities, affecting companies and investors with exposure to sanctioned parties.
